claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, dofetilide is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; its primary pharmacology is hERG (KCNH2) potassium channel blockade, and no member of the screened mechanism vocabulary shares a killing pattern driven by potassium channel blockade.
